lines.text: Assalamu alaikum. [Peace be upon you.]
Wa alaikum salam. [And upon you, peace.]
Good morning! Happy Sunday!
Barka da Juma'a! [Happy Friday!]
Sai anjima. [See you later.]
Go well. See you next Sunday.
Na gode. [Thank you.] Allah ya saka da alheri. [God reward you.]
Thank you! God bless you, eh.
Rain! Share the umbrella. Two heads, one roof.
Rain on Friday. The mats are inside. Come in, come in.
Light's gone, but the hymn knows its way. Keep singing.
No light for the microphone. His voice carries anyway.
Who took my slippers? …Oh. They're mine. Sorry, sorry.
Hurry, it's almost time. Walk fast, but walk well.
Choir practice ran long. My voice is resting till Sunday.
The tap by the mosque is working today. Alhamdulillah. [Praise God.]
Mama, wait for me! I'm coming! I'm wearing my good shoes!
After prayers, tea at Mai Shayi Audu's. Like every Friday.
Pastor Sam and Ustaz Auwal are sharing one umbrella again.
Juma'a crowd. Park well, leave space for the keke.
Somebody left a bag at the gate. Whose bag? Come and take it.
We prayed about the exams. Now we read for the exams. Both.
Late prayer done. Walk home together, it's dark.
Vigil tonight. Bring a sweater and a friend.
Candles in the chapel, lamps at the mosque. Everybody's lighting something.
Collection for the generator fund. Every little helps.
The mall played music during Juma'a. Somebody asked. They lowered it.
Fewer people at Juma'a this strike, but they're greeting harder.
Small congregation this Sunday. We sang louder to fill the room.
Food after service for the students who stayed. Take a plate. Take two.
The sermon was about honest talk. Election week. Good timing.
Don't believe everything on your phone. Check, then speak.
Final years asking for prayers. Of course. Come.
My son graduates this year. I'll be grateful in the front row.
Freshers! The mosque is there, the chapel is there. Welcome.
Exam week. Mosque full, chapel full, library full. Everybody's working.
Results day. Thanksgiving at service. Some loud, some quiet.
Allowance came. First, give a little. Then the market.
Thursday. Market first, then evening prayer, then rest.
The chapel is open for anybody who needs a quiet place.
After prayers, to the stadium! The match won't wait.
Pray for good leaders. Then go and vote for one.
Convocation thanksgiving. Families in their best, grinning.
Iftar in ten minutes! Dates are on the table, the water is cold.
Ramadan Kareem! [Blessed Ramadan!] Come and break fast with us.
Sallah tomorrow! New clothes, visits, everybody greeting!
Carol night at the chapel! Everybody's welcome. Bring your voice.
Merry Christmas! The chapel lights are on. Come and see.
Harmattan dawn. Cold water for ablution. Brrr. Bismillah. [In God's name.]
